d: On a two-man build in Alberta, Joel and his right-hand man Shawn are challenged by broken logs and stubborn headers.

Big Al puts his health on the line to break even; Nika’s brother surprises Chris with a sudden decision; Ken & Guillaume dig deep for one final pay day; and Karl fights water & time as he tries to top his 1,000 oz. goal.
Big Al's poor haul necessitates opening a new pit; a rookie miner gets Chris' dozer stuck in mud; heavy rain contributes to Karl struggling to find gold; and Bernie pushes the plant to the limit.

st: Strike While the Iron Is Hot
d: A new season starts with a bang for Chris & Nika, but Big Al has devastating setback and two new camps fight weather & bad mountain roads.
Big Al’s health takes a hit, Chris struggles with a rookie mine hand while PJ & Andy battle floods and breakdowns.
Works grinds to a halt for Big Al when Hiro’s Curse returns, while unstable ground shuts Chris down, and Riley clashes with Ed’s father-in-law.
Chris risks his season on a new cut, Andy struggles to manage the mine on his own while Ed and Riley go hunting.
A desperate Big Al pushes Hiro to the limit, Chris looks for big gear to salvage his season, while PJ & Andy’s camp has a mini-revolt.
Big Al’s plans are hurt by no-show staff, PJ’s wife questions if mining is worth it for their family, and Ed & Riley hit their stride - til they run out of fuel.
PJ & Andy’s main investor gives them an ultimatum, Chris discovers a clue that could lead to a huge payout, and Ed & Riley’s season might end early.
Breakdowns threaten Al’s chance of a profit, desperate PJ & Andy start a night shift, and Ed & Riley make a last ditch effort to prove themselves as miners.
The gold mining season begins and newcomer Big Al is off to a great start with a big gold haul.  But Bernie struggles with his rookie crew and Ken can’t get his sluicer, The Beast, up and running.

A flooding river threatens Ken’s gold camp and after a screaming match one of his workers quits.  Karl hasn’t even started sluicing while Big Al goes after 'smart' gold, but his machines keep breaking down.

Ken wonders if his gold camp is cursed while Karl copes with crew mistakes & design flaws in the big machine his Dad built.  Bernie packs it in at McDame Creek and moves his whole operation - hoping his luck will change.
After Beat and Sam build a beautiful home in Alberta, the clients egg them on to a paint ball battle on their acreage.

Beat takes on one of the most perilous builds of his career, a luxury twin-turreted vacation home on the edge of 100-foot cliff.
In Alberta, Beat is tasked with building one man’s dream home on the picturesque farmland where he grew up.
